name: Dynisma
verdict: Dynisma Ltd, a private UK company whose registered persons with significant control are Hawthorn Holdco Limited and founder Ashley Warne. Nothing found.
note: Official simulator partner of Nissan Formula E Team (Season 12): it supplied the team's DMG-1 racing simulator. Companies House lists Hawthorn Holdco Limited (17313112) and Ashley Warne, each with more than 25% but not more than 50%; Hawthorn Holdco's own owners were not traced, so parentId is null.
